anvil.label: ANVIL
anvil.role: Wing operations — the colonel running the outpost. Briefs, debriefs, owns the ROE.

disco.label: DISCO
disco.role: GCI controller on the dish-radar rock. Dry, unflappable, deadpan.

mule21.label: MULE 2-1
mule21.role: Hauler flight lead. Veteran trucker, wry.

mule23.label: MULE 2-3
mule23.role: The flight's perpetual straggler. Panics loudly, recovers fast.

lantern.label: LANTERN 5
lantern.role: Chief engineer of a crippled survey ship. Frightened, brave, polite.

nogo-warning.speaker: disco
nogo-warning.text: Flatspin, Disco. You're behind the gas. I have no picture there. Come east, now.

fail-detected.speaker: disco
fail-detected.text: Flatspin, Disco... the picket has you. You're burned. Abort, abort. R-T-B.
fail-detected.say: Flatspin, Disco... the picket has you. You're burned. Abort, abort. R.T.B.

fail-fratricide.speaker: anvil
fail-fratricide.text: Flatspin, Anvil. That was a friendly. Land. Now. We'll talk on the ground.

fail-lost.speaker: disco
fail-lost.text: Flatspin, Disco, how copy? ... Flatspin, Disco... Anvil, Disco. Flatspin is off my scope.

l1-brief-1.speaker: anvil
l1-brief-1.text: Flatspin, Anvil. Mule flight is inbound from the north with this month's resupply. Three haulers. Transponders off — standard practice this close to the gas.

l1-brief-2.speaker: anvil
l1-brief-2.text: So your radar sees three bogeys, exactly the way it would see three raiders. Close to visual range and put eyes on every one of them before they reach the pad.

l1-brief-3.speaker: anvil
l1-brief-3.text: The gas to the west is a no-go line. The Compact keeps pickets in its shadow, and Disco can't see through it. If they get a track on you, the whole approach is burned. Don't be a hero.

l1-checkin.speaker: disco
l1-checkin.text: Flatspin 1-1, Disco. Good morning. Picture: three contacts, north, slow. Call airborne.
l1-checkin.say: Flatspin one-one, Disco. Good morning. Picture: three contacts, north, slow. Call airborne.

l1-airborne.speaker: flatspin
l1-airborne.say: Disco, Flatspin one-one, airborne, as fragged.

l1-tasking.speaker: disco
l1-tasking.text: Flatspin, Disco, copy. Vector north. I'd like to know those are really Mules. Bogey dope on request.

l1-vid.speaker: flatspin
l1-vid.text: Disco, Flatspin, visual. Friendly, one Mule.

l1-mule21.speaker: mule21
l1-mule21.text: Flatspin, Mule 2-1. We see you. Nice paint job. Kindly keep your thumb off the pickle button — we're carrying the colonel's coffee.
l1-mule21.say: Flatspin, Mule two-one. We see you. Nice paint job. Kindly keep your thumb off the pickle button. We're carrying the colonel's coffee.

l1-mule22.speaker: mule22
l1-mule22.text: Mule 2-2, visual on the fighter. Er... friendly. Very friendly. Extremely friendly. Please.
l1-mule22.say: Mule two-two, visual on the fighter. Er... friendly. Very friendly. Extremely friendly. Please.

l1-mule24.speaker: mule24
l1-mule24.text: Mule 2-4. And before anyone asks — 2-3 is late again. Probably stopped for gas. The other kind.
l1-mule24.say: Mule two-four. And before anyone asks, two-three is late again. Probably stopped for gas. The other kind.

l1-complete.speaker: disco
l1-complete.text: Flatspin, Disco. All three Mules identified. Picture clean. Nice work.

l1-complete-2.speaker: anvil
l1-complete-2.text: Anvil copies. The coffee is safe. As of now you're the most popular pilot on this rock, Flatspin.

l2-brief-1.speaker: anvil
l2-brief-1.text: Flatspin, Anvil. The survey ship Lantern 5 went quiet an hour ago, mapping the far edge of the gas. Disco has a weak return drifting out of it. No drive, no transponder, no answer.
l2-brief-1.say: Flatspin, Anvil. The survey ship Lantern Five went quiet an hour ago, mapping the far edge of the gas. Disco has a weak return drifting out of it. No drive, no transponder, no answer.

l2-brief-2.speaker: anvil
l2-brief-2.text: Find her, put eyes on her, get a tow line across and drag her home. And Flatspin — something put her in that state. Assume it's still out there.

l2-checkin.speaker: disco
l2-checkin.text: Flatspin, Disco. The drifter is sliding west, toward the gas, at walking pace. If she drifts into the soup, the pickets will have her and I won't even see it. Clock's running.

l2-airborne.speaker: flatspin
l2-airborne.text: Disco, Flatspin 1-1, airborne. Heading for the drifter.
l2-airborne.say: Disco, Flatspin one-one, airborne. Heading for the drifter.

l2-tasking.speaker: disco
l2-tasking.text: Copy, Flatspin. Your contact is north-northwest. Buster.

l2-vid.speaker: flatspin
l2-vid.say: Lantern Five, Flatspin one-one. Visual. How copy?

l2-lantern-1.speaker: lantern
l2-lantern-1.text: Flatspin... oh, thank God. Lantern 5. Reactor scrammed, we're on batteries, eleven souls aboard. We have air for a while. Not a long while.
l2-lantern-1.say: Flatspin... oh, thank God. Lantern Five. Reactor scrammed, we're on batteries, eleven souls aboard. We have air for a while. Not a long while.

l2-alongside.speaker: flatspin
l2-alongside.text: Lantern, Flatspin. Coming alongside. Stand by for the tow line.

l2-hooked.speaker: lantern
l2-hooked.text: Line's fast — we're hooked up! Take us home, Flatspin. And please don't take the scenic route.

l2-popup.speaker: disco
l2-popup.text: Flatspin, Disco! Pop-up contact, single, out of the gas, hot. That'll be whoever hit Lantern. Declared hostile. You are cleared hot.

l2-scared.speaker: lantern
l2-scared.text: Flatspin, that thing is pointed straight at us!

l2-thanks.speaker: lantern
l2-thanks.text: Was that... for us? Thank you. Sincerely. I'm naming a crater after you. A big one.

l2-complete.speaker: disco
l2-complete.text: Flatspin, Disco. Lantern 5 is on the pad. Eleven souls, all accounted for.
l2-complete.say: Flatspin, Disco. Lantern Five is on the pad. Eleven souls, all accounted for.

l2-complete-2.speaker: anvil
l2-complete-2.text: Anvil copies. Good work, Flatspin. Drinks are on the survey corps tonight. They just don't know it yet.

l2-fail-drift.speaker: disco
l2-fail-drift.text: Flatspin, Disco. Lantern 5 has drifted into the gas. I've lost her.
l2-fail-drift.say: Flatspin, Disco. Lantern Five has drifted into the gas. I've lost her.

l2-fail-lost.speaker: disco
l2-fail-lost.text: Lantern 5, Disco, how copy? ... Lantern 5, Disco... Anvil, Disco. Lantern 5 is off my scope.
l2-fail-lost.say: Lantern Five, Disco, how copy? ... Lantern Five, Disco... Anvil, Disco. Lantern Five is off my scope.

l3-brief-1.speaker: anvil
l3-brief-1.text: Flatspin, Anvil. Two hours ago the picket line behind the gas went dark. Either they've gone home, or they're coming through. Nobody on this rock believes they've gone home.

l3-brief-2.speaker: anvil
l3-brief-2.text: Your job is to hold the door. Anything hostile that comes out of that cloud does not reach the pad or the dish.

l3-checkin.speaker: disco
l3-checkin.text: Flatspin, Disco. One more thing: Mule 2-3 is still overdue, last seen on the far side of the gas. So when something comes out of that cloud — you look before you shoot.
l3-checkin.say: Flatspin, Disco. One more thing: Mule two-three is still overdue, last seen on the far side of the gas. So when something comes out of that cloud, you look before you shoot.

l3-airborne.speaker: flatspin
l3-airborne.text: Disco, Flatspin 1-1, airborne. Holding east of the gas.
l3-airborne.say: Disco, Flatspin one-one, airborne. Holding east of the gas.

l3-tasking.speaker: disco
l3-tasking.text: Copy, Flatspin. Set up a CAP between the gas and the pad. Nothing on my scope. Yet.

l3-popup-mule.speaker: disco
l3-popup-mule.text: Flatspin, Disco. Pop-up contact, single, emerging from the gas, heading for the pad. No squawk. Declare bogey. Go VID — do not engage.
l3-popup-mule.say: Flatspin, Disco. Pop-up contact, single, emerging from the gas, heading for the pad. No squawk. Declare bogey. Go V.I.D. Do not engage.

l3-mule23-1.speaker: mule23
l3-mule23-1.text: Don't shoot! Don't shoot! Mule 2-3, friendly, friendly! My transponder's been dead since Tuesday — I filed a ticket!
l3-mule23-1.say: Don't shoot! Don't shoot! Mule two-three, friendly, friendly! My transponder's been dead since Tuesday, I filed a ticket!

l3-vid-mule.speaker: flatspin
l3-vid-mule.text: Disco, Flatspin, visual. Friendly, Mule 2-3. He's late.
l3-vid-mule.say: Disco, Flatspin, visual. Friendly, Mule two-three. He's late.

l3-mule23-2.speaker: mule23
l3-mule23-2.text: Late, he says. I've had company since the far side of the gas. Two of them. Pretty sure they're right behind me.

l3-popup-raid.speaker: disco
l3-popup-raid.text: Flatspin, Disco! Two new contacts, out of the gas behind Mule. Hostile, hostile. Flatspin, you are cleared hot.

l3-condition-red.speaker: anvil
l3-condition-red.text: All stations, Anvil. Condition red. This is not a drill.

l3-one-left.speaker: disco
l3-one-left.text: Disco copies splash. One bandit remaining.

l3-mule-landed.speaker: mule23
l3-mule-landed.text: Mule 2-3 is down and safe. Flatspin — next time I'm late, I'm blaming you.
l3-mule-landed.say: Mule two-three is down and safe. Flatspin, next time I'm late, I'm blaming you.

l3-complete.speaker: disco
l3-complete.text: Flatspin, Disco. Picture clean. No further contacts from the gas.

l3-complete-2.speaker: anvil
l3-complete-2.text: Flatspin, Anvil. The door held. Good hunting today. And would somebody please fix Mule 2-3's transponder.
l3-complete-2.say: Flatspin, Anvil. The door held. Good hunting today. And would somebody please fix Mule two-three's transponder.

l3-fail-raid.speaker: anvil
l3-fail-raid.text: They're through! All stations, Anvil — take cover, take cover!

l3-fail-lost.speaker: disco
l3-fail-lost.text: Mule 2-3, Disco, how copy? ... Anvil, Disco. Mule 2-3 is off my scope.
l3-fail-lost.say: Mule two-three, Disco, how copy? ... Anvil, Disco. Mule two-three is off my scope.
